item.title: Israeli settler charged over Palestinian activist’s killing
item.description: Israeli prosecutors have charged a settler with “reckless manslaughter” in the killing of prominent Palestinian activist

item.title: Deadly explosion on minibus near Damascus
item.description: Two people were killed and 13 injured when an explosion ripped through a minibus in Jaramana, southeast of Damascus.

item.title: US ends cap on local TV station owners amid concerns of media consolidation
item.description: Critics say the 39 percent cap was a safeguard against excessive concentration of media ownership in the US.

item.title: Vinicius Jr extends Real Madrid deal to 2032, ending transfer speculation
item.description: The 26-year-old Brazil international had been linked with a move to English champions Arsenal.

item.title: Israeli attacks wound eight in Lebanon despite Rome talks
item.description: Israel launches strikes on southern Lebanon's Tyre as third day of the seventh round of US-brokered talks concludes.

item.title: Sudan war threatens ancient Meroe pyramids
item.description: Sudan’s ongoing war is endangering the ancient Meroe pyramids, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

item.title: The biggest AI bill for parents yet?
item.description: Congress is pushing a new bill forward that would give parents the power over their kid’s interactions with AI chatbots.

item.title: CDC says US salmonella outbreak tied to jalapeno peppers from Mexico
item.description: Salmonella outbreak sickens hundreds across 27 US states.

item.title: Ceuta’s leader says 100 died in border rush as up to 5,000 still in enclave
item.description: After migrant surge from Morocco, EU says Spain assured Schengen is safe but warns Europe's borders are 'vulnerable'.

item.title: Poll suggests US adults are facing increased strain from extreme heat
item.description: More than half of Americans told the AP-NORC poll that climate change is happening, a slight decline from last year.

item.title: Women expose rape as a weapon of war in Sudan
item.description: Women displaced by Sudan's war are speaking publicly about surviving rape by Rapid Support Forces fighters.

item.title: Houthis launch deadly attacks on Saudi-led coalition forces in Yemen
item.description: Yemen's Houthis say they launched drones and ballistic missiles in Marib and Hadramout.

item.title: Two killed, several wounded in minibus blast near Syria’s Damascus
item.description: Body parts found at scene and at least 13 wounded after explosion on minibus in town of Jaramana, health ministry says.

item.title: Is Israel’s Netanyahu preparing to fight Iran alone?
item.description: Experts question Netanyahu's strategy, labelling US war on Iran a strategic failure with global economic impacts.

item.title: Parker’s positive cocaine test caused by nutritionist, doping body says
item.description: The 34-year-old boxer tested positive for cocaine on day of shock loss to Fabio Wardley in London in October.

item.title: Eight countries ‘strongly denounce’ ongoing Israeli violations in Gaza
item.description: Foreign ministers of Arab and Muslim nations slam Israel targeting Gaza's hospitals, demand action to protect medics.

item.title: Argentina won’t retaliate after Brazil downgrades diplomatic ties
item.description: Buenos Aires says it will not respond after Brasilia reduced diplomatic ties over Milei’s latest attacks on Lula.

item.title: US seeks extradition of Filipino church leader accused of fraud, sex crimes
item.description: Apollo Quiboloy leads the Kingdom of Jesus Christ church, which was founded in 1985 in Davao and has branches in US.

item.title: Israel indicts settler in rare charge over Palestinian activist’s killing
item.description: Awdah Hathaleen, who worked on the Oscar-winning documentary No Other Land, was killed last July in occupied West Bank.

item.title: Saudi Arabia names commander for maritime defence coalition
item.description: Rear Admiral Abdullah bin Salem Al-Shehri will lead multinational coalition's naval defence to secure vital waterways.

item.title: Trump vows to find ‘leakers’ after reports of depleted Iran war munitions
item.description: US President defends Pentagon chief Hegseth following report of confrontation over dwindling weapons supply.

item.title: UNICEF says one child killed per day in Gaza since ‘ceasefire’
item.description: At least 300 children reported killed in Gaza in 300 days since October 2025 truce between Israel and Hamas was agreed.

item.title: War on Iran: Iran and Oman agree on Strait of Hormuz deal
item.description: Iran and Oman agree on new coordinates for ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Real Madrid sign Ivory Coast’s Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig
item.description: The Bundesliga Young Player of the Season in 2025/26 reportedly signed for record fee on deal until 2033.

item.title: UEFA says FIFA boycott remains despite Infantino World Cup selloff U-turn
item.description: European football's governing body says FIFA has not met conditions to end the boycott of their return to global game.
